_meta.source: main page: buzz words, mission ('how we self-organise')

failure_modes: Hidden coordinator: order attributed to self-organisation is actually imposed by an unnoticed central signal
Designed order mistaken for emergent order because the designer is out of view
Runaway feedback: local amplification locks the system into a rigid or degenerate pattern
gloss: Global order that arises from local interactions, with no component holding the blueprint
invariants: No central controller specifies the global pattern
The global pattern cannot be read off any single component
Removing the interactions removes the order, even if every component is intact
mechanism: Many components interact, each following rules that use only locally available signals. Order at a larger scale, such as a pattern, structure or collective behaviour, appears from those interactions. No component stores or specifies the global pattern, and the order persists only while the interactions and the energy or information flow feeding them continue.
